title: Rehoboam
subtitle: 1 Kings 12–14 | 17 yrs
description: Son of Solomon; rejected elders' advice causing the 10 northern tribes to rebel under Jeroboam.

title: Abijah (Abijam)
subtitle: 1 Kings 15 | 3 yrs
description: Fought against Jeroboam of Israel; won a major battle through divine intervention despite personal shortcomings.

title: Asa
subtitle: 1 Kings 15 | 41 yrs
description: A godly reformer who removed idols and defeated the Ethiopian army; relied on Syria later in life.

title: Jehoshaphat
subtitle: 1 Kings 22 | 25 yrs
description: Sent teachers with God's Law throughout Judah; made an unwise military alliance with Ahab.

title: Jehoram
subtitle: 2 Kings 8 | 8 yrs
description: Married Athaliah, Ahab's daughter; introduced Baal worship to Judah and murdered his brothers.

title: Ahaziah
subtitle: 2 Kings 8 | 1 yr
description: Followed the house of Ahab; killed by Jehu while visiting King Joram of Israel.

title: Athaliah (Queen)
subtitle: 2 Kings 11 | 6 yrs
description: Usurped the throne after her son's death and attempted to exterminate the royal line of David.

title: Joash (Jehoash)
subtitle: 2 Kings 12 | 40 yrs
description: Hidden as a child by Jehoiada the priest; repaired the Temple, but lapsed after Jehoiada died.

title: Amaziah
subtitle: 2 Kings 14 | 29 yrs
description: Defeated Edom; grew proud and challenged Northern Israel to war, resulting in Jerusalem's wall being breached.

title: Uzziah (Azariah)
subtitle: 2 Chronicles 26 | 52 yrs
description: Strengthened Judah militarily and economically; struck with leprosy for arrogantly burning incense in the Temple.

title: Jotham
subtitle: 2 Kings 15 | 16 yrs
description: Rebuilt the Upper Gate of the Temple and fortified Judah; served as co-regent during Uzziah's leprosy.

title: Ahaz
subtitle: 2 Kings 16 | 16 yrs
description: Practiced child sacrifice, closed the Temple doors, and paid Assyria for protection against Israel and Syria.

title: Hezekiah
subtitle: 2 Kings 18–20 | 29 yrs
description: Judah's greatest reformer; destroyed the high places, built Hezekiah's Tunnel, and prayed as God destroyed Assyria's siege.

title: Manasseh
subtitle: 2 Kings 21 | 55 yrs
description: Judah's longest-reigning and most wicked king; shed innocent blood, but repented late in life while captive in Babylon.

title: Amon
subtitle: 2 Kings 21 | 2 yrs
description: Continued Manasseh's idolatrous practices without repenting; assassinated by his own servants.

title: Josiah
subtitle: 2 Kings 22–23 | 31 yrs
description: Boy king who discovered the Book of the Law, purged idol worship, and celebrated Passover; killed fighting Egypt at Megiddo.

title: Jehoahaz
subtitle: 2 Kings 23 | 3 months
description: Ruled 3 months before Pharaoh Necho deposed him and took him in chains to Egypt where he died.

title: Jehoiakim
subtitle: 2 Kings 23–24 | 11 yrs
description: Placed on throne by Egypt; burned Jeremiah's prophetic scroll; experienced Nebuchadnezzar's first siege (605 BC).

title: Jehoiachin
subtitle: 2 Kings 24 | 3 months
description: Surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar and was carried captive to Babylon along with Ezekiel and Judah's nobility.

title: Zedekiah
subtitle: 2 Kings 24–25 | 11 yrs
description: Judah's final king; rebelled against Babylon resulting in the destruction of Jerusalem and Solomonic Temple in 586 BC.
